Documentation

Plugin quick starts

Quick starts, installation, commands, permissions and configuration for the plugins in the ArkFlame catalogue.

48 plugin guides, with the details you need to get each one running.

Security

  • AuthMe Premium install and topology

    How AuthMe Premium's proxy session bridge modes differ and what each backend needs. Updated 2026-10-30

  • ChatSentinel chat filtering and SocialSpy

    ChatSentinel filters chat for spam, swearing, advertising and client mentions, with server mute, SocialSpy and Redis alerts. Commands and permissions. Updated 2026-10-30

  • ExploitFixer quick start

    Packet-level crash and exploit filter for Spigot, Paper, and Folia servers, built around the required HamsterAPI packet engine. Updated 2026-10-30

  • FairPlay quick start

    Combat anticheat that applies mitigation against flagged players, with built-in checks and optional GrimAC or Vulcan flag hooks. Updated 2026-10-30

Performance

  • BlockLimiter per-chunk block limits

    BlockLimiter caps block counts per chunk, set per block type, to limit load and persistence cost from dense player builds. Compatibility overview. Updated 2026-11-07

  • EntityLimiter entity caps

    EntityLimiter sets hard caps on entity counts to prevent crash and lag from entity pressure. Compatibility and configuration overview. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FlamePaper features and compatibility

    FlamePaper is a Paper 1.8.8 server fork carrying patches for stability, redstone behaviour, knockback and the tick loop. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FlameStack dropped-item stacking

    FlameStack merges dropped items through a chunk-section index and a bounded reservation coordinator. Defaults, commands and Folia notes. Updated 2026-10-30

  • MobStacker stacking and entity counts

    MobStacker merges nearby mobs of the same type to reduce entity counts and tick cost. Platforms, compatibility and configuration overview. Updated 2026-11-07

  • RedstoneLimiter configuration and monitor mode

    RedstoneLimiter scopes, presets, monitor mode, commands, permissions and configuration keys. Updated 2026-10-30

Network

  • DiscordFlow features and compatibility

    DiscordFlow connects a Minecraft network to Discord for role sync, chat sync, proximity voice and console access. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FlameCord quick start

    BungeeCord and Waterfall fork proxy with antibot filtering, packet limits, and an optional iptables/ipset firewall module. Updated 2026-10-30

  • VeloFlame quick start

    Velocity proxy fork adding antibot, rate limiting, firewall, whitelist, and maintenance commands, built with a Java 25 toolchain. Updated 2026-10-30

Gameplay

  • Crates features and compatibility

    Crates is an HCF-oriented crate and reward system. The plugin descriptor covers a single command and requires HolographicDisplays. Updated 2026-11-07

  • Disasters features and compatibility

    Disasters implements a Hypixel-style Disasters minigame on Paper. The current source targets Paper 26.2 and Java 25, and requires WorldEdit. Updated 2026-11-07

  • EssentialsLite features and compatibility

    EssentialsLite is a broad essentials command suite covering teleports, homes, kits, warps and administration. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FancyGlow features and compatibility

    FancyGlow lets eligible players choose a glow colour through a menu, with TAB as the display integration. Glow definitions, menus and messages are configurable. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FlameForge features and compatibility

    FlameForge adds custom weapons, upgrades and reforging. It documents Spigot, Paper and Folia support across 1.8.8 to 1.21.x and ships twenty-two permissions. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FlamePearls features and compatibility

    FlamePearls corrects ender-pearl movement glitches and supports limiting stasis chambers. Behaviour is controlled from a single config file. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FlamePractice features and compatibility

    FlamePractice runs duel, ranked and FFA practice on a Spigot-based server. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FloatingHeads features and compatibility

    FloatingHeads renders floating heads, NPC-style displays and holograms. Updated 2026-11-07

  • HarvestableBlocks features and compatibility

    HarvestableBlocks defines mining and farming zones whose blocks and crops regenerate after harvest. Zone protection plugins can govern where the loops run. Updated 2026-11-07

  • HubCombat features and compatibility

    HubCombat adds PvP and weapons to a lobby server. It targets Paper 1.21.7 with Java 21 and exposes a reload command plus an admin permission. Updated 2026-11-07

  • Leash Workers features and compatibility

    Leash Workers lets players leash entities and assigns configured jobs to villagers. Updated 2026-11-07

  • Lucky Pillars features and compatibility

    Lucky Pillars implements the Pillars of Fortune minigame. Five commands, twenty-four permissions and configuration for GUIs, hotbars and messages. Updated 2026-11-07

  • MineClans features and compatibility

    MineClans provides clans with power, land claiming, alliances and events. Updated 2026-11-07

  • MineClasses features and compatibility

    MineClasses assigns MMORPG or HCF classes through armour and applies their potion effects automatically. Class definitions and messages are configurable. Updated 2026-11-07

  • MineKoth features and compatibility

    MineKoth runs time-limited capture-the-hill events with rewards. It integrates with Vault, MineClans, UltimateClans, holograms and PlaceholderAPI. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SH-Koth features and compatibility

    SH-Koth runs King-of-the-Hill events with Folia support. Operational documentation is maintained by the author. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SH-Pets features and compatibility

    SH-Pets adds companion pets with abilities and events. Ten pet definition files and a level curve sit behind a PacketEvents dependency. Updated 2026-11-07

  • sLevels features and compatibility

    sLevels adds server-wide level progression with rewards. Levels are defined in configuration and can run on Spigot, Paper or Folia. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SquidGameX features and compatibility

    SquidGameX runs large Squid Game-style events with a set of game and configuration files. It is built for Bukkit, Spigot, Paper and Folia servers. Updated 2026-11-07

  • StaffModeX staff mode, vanish and reports

    StaffModeX adds staff mode, vanish, staff chat, freeze, reports and inspection tools to Bukkit servers, with optional proxy and Redis transport. Updated 2026-10-30

SMP

  • FlameOrders features and compatibility

    FlameOrders provides server-synchronized orders and deliveries, with storage and network modes. It ships a command and permission table and supports Folia. Updated 2026-11-07

  • FlameSpawners features and compatibility

    FlameSpawners adds configurable spawners with stacking, storage and upgrades. Updated 2026-11-07

  • ProtectionStones Extras features and compatibility

    ProtectionStones Extras adds GUI management, region flags and bans to ProtectionStones. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Combat features and compatibility

    SMP Combat adds combat tags with legacy-combat, WorldGuard-barrier and elytra restrictions. Ten configuration files cover the rules. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Crates features and compatibility

    SMP Crates is a configurable crate system. It documents Bukkit, Spigot and Paper 1.8–1.21+ support and declares Folia compatibility. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Harvest features and compatibility

    SMP Harvest adds harvest progression with upgradable hoes, XP, tokens and rewards. Eight configuration files and thirty-two permissions cover the loop. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Lifesteal commands and configuration

    SMP Lifesteal commands, permissions, storage defaults and heart-death settings for survival servers. Updated 2026-10-30

  • SMP Lobby features and compatibility

    SMP Lobby builds a lobby server with PvP, announcements, protection, titles, redirect and void protection. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Menus features and compatibility

    SMP Menus provides help and rules menus as an alternative to DeluxeMenus. Menus are defined in configuration with a menu-driven interface. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Protections features and compatibility

    SMP Protections provides ProtectionStones-style claims with menus. It requires SMP Regions at runtime and is configured through a main config and messages file. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Punishments operations and configuration

    SMP Punishments commands, permissions, storage and warning settings, including multi-server sync. Updated 2026-10-30

  • SMP Regions resets, flags and commands

    SMP Regions resets tracked temporary blocks in cuboid regions on a timer. Flags, commands, permissions and cache behaviour. Updated 2026-10-30

  • SMP Rewards features and compatibility

    SMP Rewards adds daily and hourly rewards with streaks, menus and playtime tracking. Four commands and ten permissions cover configuration and player access. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Shards features and compatibility

    SMP Shards adds an AFK-earned shard currency and a shop that spends it. The current source targets Paper and Folia 1.21.4+ and ships nine configuration files. Updated 2026-11-07

  • SMP Weapons features and compatibility

    SMP Weapons adds configurable legendary weapons for SMP, PvP and FFA play. Arsenal menus, item definitions and messages are included. Updated 2026-11-07
